source_stage: R6 bounded 180-person diagnostic; detailed tracing ON
limits: Entry estimate includes request delivery and upstream/framework dispatch; it is not all queueing.
SQL and commit-hook intervals can overlap; component sums are not a full partition.
Autocommit statement duration includes its implicit commit.
100 ms database samples do not rule out shorter waits; wall-clock interval matches are approximate.
Detailed tracing changes overhead and is excluded from formal performance acceptance.
Transaction duration lower bounds begin at first profiled SQL because BEGIN was not independently profiled.
Entry time includes upstream delivery and framework work; it is not a pure Gunicorn queue measurement.
